name: conftest.py
summary: Pytest configuration module providing shared Django test fixtures and environment setup for the backend test suite.
purpose: Centralizes test infrastructure configuration and reusable fixture definitions to eliminate setup duplication across backend tests, enabling consistent and isolated test environments for Django API and model testing.
responsibilities: Configure Django environment for pytest execution
Provide reusable pytest fixtures for test dependencies
Instantiate DRF APIClient for integration testing
Create standardized test user and dataset model instances
Ensure consistent test data setup across the backend test suite
inputs: Database access for model fixture persistence
outputs: DRF APIClient instances for HTTP request simulation
architecture_notes: Serves as the root test infrastructure layer using the pytest conftest.py pattern to inject dependencies across the backend test hierarchy. Implements the Fixture pattern for reusable test resources, separating test data construction from test logic. Centralizes Django setup (likely including settings module configuration and django.setup() invocation) to ensure the ORM and application registry are initialized before fixture execution. Provides domain-specific fixtures (user, dataset) that couple the test suite to the authentication and data models, suggesting an integration testing strategy that spans API clients through to persistence.
improvements: Extract Django environment setup into a dedicated pytest plugin or setup.cfg/pytest.ini configuration to declutter fixture definitions
Replace hardcoded model fixtures with factory_boy or pytest-factoryboy for more flexible and maintainable test data generation
Add explicit scope annotations (e.g., session, function) to fixtures to optimize test execution performance
Introduce type hints to fixture return types for improved static analysis and developer experience
Consider splitting domain-specific fixtures (dataset) into domain conftest.py files closer to the relevant application modules
